# 📢 Changelog v2.5 → v2.6.1
### Late May 2026
## 💫  New Features
### 🌟 Major Additions:
> - **Round Robin Turn Fairness Adjustment** — When picking the next writer in a story, the number of most recent writers excluded from the pool is now based on the total group size. For example:
>   - 1-2 writers: exclude none
>   - 3-4 writers: exclude only the writer who just finalized their turn
>   - 5–9 writers: exclude the last 2
>   - 10–15: exclude the last 3
>   - 10+: exclude 4...no scaling past this point. If you have more than ten writers in a story, I want to hear about it!!  😂
> - **Draft Preservation** — If your turn ends before you can finalize your writing, you won't lose it anymore! You now have 24 hours to retrieve the text. If you skip with content in your turn thread, the system will ask you to confirm if you want to keep it for a day, or allow it to be deleted immediately.

### ✨ Minor Additions:
> - **Turn notifications** — Notifications now announce what mode the story is in (Normal/Quick/Slow), and include a relative timestamp that will count down how much time you have until a reminder is sent, and when your turn ends.
> - **`/story help`** — Restructured as a table of contents with select menu navigation; expanded to 7 pages including a new Reading & Editing page.
> - **FAQ forum sync** — Help content now syncs to a <#1499454495044927739>  forum channel here on the Hub, and re-syncs whenever the help text is changed.
> - **`/storyadmin manage`** — Renamed to `/storyadmin user`, since its only for changing user-related information now. All story administration is done through `/story manage`.

## 🛠️ Improvements
> - **System Setup Save** — The warning to save your settings was reformatted and placed in the header and footer so hopefully it cant be missed!
> - **`/mystory list`** — Overhauled this view with better organization and turn status indicators.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
> - **Unable to Add Story** — There was a CreateStory column mismatch keeping new stories from being created.
> - **Code Housekeeping** — Split a lot of logic off to reduce file sizes and make them easier to track, updated a lot of system logging.
> - **Roundup deduplication** — Tightened checks to ensure the Roundup isnt posted more than once.
> - **AO3 references** — Removed from all user-facing text except export instructions.
